rejected_detail.title: load_demo_spawns unused perr = Odin compile error (build-breaking)
rejected_detail.why_rejected: Empirically false: `odin build harness` (with -debug and -strict-style) exits 0 with no perr/unused/error/warning. Odin permits the unused second value of a multi-return binding. The lenient parse (return empty on missing/unparseable demo) is the documented intent. No issue.

rejected_detail.title: keystone assertion claims a 'serialized tick field' that is absent from the diff
rejected_detail.why_rejected: False: serialize.odin:73 `w_u64(&w, state.tick)` serializes the tick, and step.odin:28 `state.tick = tick` advances it each tick — so hashes vary tick-to-tick for this exact reason. The comment is accurate; the lens only read the diff hunk and missed the pre-existing serialized tick field above the flow block.

findings.title: spawn_tick proc (demo.odin) is dead code; lower_spawns (run.odin) inlines the identical tick formula
findings.evidence:
harness/demo.odin: `spawn_tick :: proc(s: ^Spawn_Intent, logic_hz: i32) -> u64 { return u64(max(0, i64(s.at_ms) * i64(logic_hz) / 1000)) }`
harness/run.odin lower_spawns: `tick := u64(max(0, i64(s.at_ms) * i64(hz) / 1000)); pp.flow_seed_demand(&state.flow, tick, s.src, s.dst)`
grep `spawn_tick(` across harness/app/core: zero callers (only the def + the unrelated Packet.spawn_tick FIELD).
findings.detail: The two formulas AGREE (both floor(at_ms*hz/1000), no +1) so there is NO current determinism bug. But spawn_tick is a newly-added orphan and lower_spawns is its only logical consumer, duplicating the formula instead of calling it — a latent divergence hazard on the replay-identical-demand invariant.
findings.recommended_fix: In lower_spawns call `tick := spawn_tick(&s, hz)` (de-duplicate), or delete the unused spawn_tick proc.

findings.title: flow_step's defensive severance branch resets to p.src (original source), not the lost edge's departure node as its comment claims
findings.evidence:
core/flow.odin:
```
ps, ok := pipe_slot(&state.topology, p.edge)
if !ok {
    // ... Drop back to the departure side of the lost edge + re-forward next tick.
    p.on_edge = false
    p.at_node = p.src
    p.progress_units = 0
    continue
}
```
p.src is never reassigned anywhere in flow_step (grep `\.src =` -> only this line reads it), so for a multi-hop packet p.src is still the ORIGINAL spawn source.
findings.detail: Unreachable in 1.3 (pipes are never removed, so pipe_slot always succeeds) — no functional impact now. But it pre-implements slice-2.3 severance and its reset contradicts the comment: a multi-hop packet mid edge N would teleport back to its origin, not re-forward from the lost edge's departure node (the non-heading endpoint of p.edge).
findings.recommended_fix: Drop the branch (unreachable in 1.3; severance is slice 2.3) or reset to the lost edge's departure node: the p.edge endpoint that isn't p.heading.

findings.title: flow_seed_demand / Spawn_Intent parse accept any src/dst id with no live-node check
findings.evidence:
core/flow.odin: `flow_seed_demand :: proc(f: ^Flow_State, tick: u64, src, dst: u32) { append(&f.demand, Spawn_Req{tick = tick, src = src, dst = dst}) }`
harness/demo.odin spawn parse: only checks parseability (`if !oka || !okb { return ... }`), not node liveness.
findings.detail: No guard rejects a non-live node id. A typo'd id spawns a packet at a non-existent node; routing_next_hop then returns ok=false forever, so it silently never delivers and never visibly renders — a ghost packet. Not triggered by current valid inputs (src==dst IS handled — flow_step marks it delivered at spawn).
findings.recommended_fix: Validate src/dst at the lowering boundary (lower_spawns / app seed) where the Topology is available — reject non-live ids with a typed error before flow_seed_demand.

findings.title: Advisory test gate: PASS (8/8 traced behaviours covered)
findings.evidence: 5 new @(test) funcs pin: per-hop source->sink, forwarding-table rebuild on topology change (rule 1), no-cached-route re-forward after rebuild (E29), flow replay byte-identical (E10), unroutable-waits-then-flows (E28). T2 mid-traversal harness golden (demos/flow.dem captures at 2100/2150/2250ms) verified non-black. Packet_Arrived+cull + id-0 transitively exercised.
findings.detail: P0 4/4=100%, P1 4/4=100%, overall 8/8=100%. ECMP/QoS/SLA/demolish correctly out of scope for 1.3. Gate green; no gaps.
findings.recommended_fix: No action. Optional later: a dedicated id-0 @(test) to pin the on_edge sentinel explicitly (currently transitively covered).

verdict_reason: 0 blockers, 0 warnings. The load-bearing invariants all hold and are verified: per-hop forwarding (no route[] field, no compute_route, no BFS-on-packet), 4-rule-spine rule-1 table rebuild gated on Topology.gen, id-0 handled via on_edge flag + +1 id scheme, engine-free core, and replay-determinism over the flow (demand re-created identically in both live + replay paths; standalone harness replay bit-for-bit). odin test (20), lint (4 gates), app build, and the software-renderer harness (boot/flow/draw green) all pass. The 4 notes are non-blocking (dead helper, an unreachable-in-1.3 defensive branch, an unvalidated-input latent gap, and the coverage gate).
